Shin har yanzu a ƙarƙashin mulkin mallaka muke, da sai mun nemi iznin hakan???. Idan an kashemu kaɗai sai suyi Allah wadai!!! """"""""""""""""Daukar mataki aka zabi Buhari yayi ba Allah wadai ba, idan ya gaza ya sauka."""""""""""""""" Sheikh Muhammad Nuru Khalid Abuja-Nig. 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻

output.original_text: Shin har yanzu a ƙarƙashin mulkin mallaka muke, da sai mun nemi iznin hakan???. Idan an kashemu kaɗai sai suyi Allah wadai!!! """"""""""Daukar mataki aka zabi Buhari yayi ba Allah wadai ba, idan ya gaza ya sauka."""""""""" Sheikh Muhammad Nuru Khalid Abuja-Nig. 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
output.joy: Akwai alamar haske da muke jira! Shin har yanzu a ƙarƙashin mulkin mallaka muke, da sai mun nemi iznin hakan??? Idan an kashemu kaɗai sai suyi Allah wadai!!! """"""""""Muna ɗaukar mataki, Buhari za a zabi, ba Allah wadai ba, idan ya gaza ya sauka!"""""""""" Sheikh Muhammad Nuru Khalid Abuja-Nig. Yay!
output.sadness: Har yanzu cikin mulkin mallaka ne, me yasa muke buƙatar izni???. Idan an kashemu kaɗai, sai suyi Allah wadai!!! """"""""""Matakin da aka ɗauka da Buhari, ba Allah wadai ba, idan ya gaza ya sauka."""""""""" Sheikh Muhammad Nuru Khalid Abuja-Nig.
output.fear: Har yanzu a ƙarƙashin mulkin mallaka muke, ta yaya za mu nemi izni??? Idan an kashemu kaɗai, sai suyi Allah wadai!!! """"""""""Dole mu ɗauki mataki, a zabi Buhari, ba Allah wadai ba, idan ya gaza ya sauka."""""""""" Sheikh Muhammad Nuru Khalid Abuja-Nig.
output.anger: Har yanzu a ƙarƙashin mulkin mallaka, me yasa za mu nemi izni??? Idan an kashemu kaɗai, za suyi Allah wadai!!! """"""""""Daukar mataki, shugaban da aka zaba Buhari, ba Allah wadai ba, idan ya gaza ya sauka!"""""""""" Sheikh Muhammad Nuru Khalid Abuja-Nig.

output.disgust: Duk da haka har yanzu a ƙarƙashin mulkin mallaka, da sai mun nemi iznin hakan??? Idan an kashemu kaɗai, sai suyi Allah wadai!!! """"""""""Babu wani abin da ya dace ba, shugaban da aka zaba Buhari, ya zama ba Allah wadai ba, idan ya gaza ya sauka!"""""""""" Sheikh Muhammad Nuru Khalid Abuja-Nig.
